title.zh: 掺杂与热预算：注入后还要激活
title.en: Doping and thermal budget: activation is needed after implantation

subtitle.en: Dose, energy, angle, activation and diffusion

body.zh: 1 掩膜准备；SiO₂；Si；• 薄膜/光刻形成掩膜；• 开口定义掺杂区域；• 掩膜材料与厚度影响；角度/选择性（Shadowing），
body.en: 1 Mask preparation SiO₂ Si • Form the mask by thin-film deposition / lithography • Openings define doped regions • Mask material and thickness affect angle / selectivity (shadowing)

body.zh: 2 离子注入；离子源；（B, P, As, BF₂⁺ 等）；质量分析；选择；加速电场；加电场；（Tilt）；旋转；（Rotation）；• 离子经加速后穿过掩膜进入硅中；• Tilt-Rotation 减少沟道效应与不均匀；• 能量决定穿透深度，剂量决定注入量
body.en: 2 Ion implantation Ion source (B, P, As, BF₂⁺, etc.) Mass analysis Selection Accelerating electric field Applied electric field (Tilt) Rotation (Rotation) • Accelerated ions pass through the mask and enter silicon • Tilt–rotation reduces channeling and nonuniformity • Energy determines penetration depth; dose determines implanted amount

body.zh: 3 去胶/清洗；Rp（投影射程）；深度；Si；• 去除光刻胶与残留物；• 避免有机残留造成缺陷；或污染
body.en: 3 Strip / clean Rp (projected range) Depth Si • Remove resist and residue • Avoid defects caused by organic residue or contamination

body.zh: 4 退火激活；高温退火（RTA/Spike/炉管等）；掺杂原子（已占位）；硅原子；晶格空位/缺陷；• 修复注入损伤：间隙/空位消除；• 掺杂原子占据替位 → 电学激活；• 同时发生扩散 → 结加深与展宽；并非所有注入的离子都会被电学激活
body.en: 4 Anneal activation High-temperature anneal (RTA / spike / furnace, etc.) Dopant atom (occupying a site) Silicon atom Lattice vacancy / defect • Repair implantation damage: remove interstitials / vacancies • Dopants occupy substitutional sites → electrical activation • Diffusion occurs simultaneously → deeper, broader junctions Not all implanted ions become electrically active

body.zh: • 电学量測评估掺杂效果；•验证片电阻、接触电阻、；结深/结形貌等；• 反馈工艺调整
body.en: • Assess doping by electrical measurements • Verify sheet resistance, contact resistance, junction depth/profile, etc. • Feed back process adjustments

body.zh: 关键控制；Dose；（剂量）
body.en: Key controls Dose (dose)

body.zh: Energy；（能量）
body.en: Energy (energy)

body.zh: Tilt-Rotation；（倾斜-旋转）
body.en: Tilt–rotation (tilt and rotation)

body.zh: Anneal；Temperature-Time；（退火温度-时间）
body.en: Anneal Temperature–time (anneal temperature and time)

body.zh: 2 物理量要分清；Dose → 注入总量
body.en: 2 Distinguish physical quantities Dose → total implanted amount

body.zh: Energy → 深度分布；浓度；深度
body.en: Energy → depth distribution Concentration Depth

body.zh: Activation + Diffusion；→ 最终有效掺杂与结形貌；浓度；---注入后（未退火）；退火后（有效掺杂）；深度
body.en: Activation + diffusion → final effective doping and junction profile Concentration After implantation (unannealed) After annealing (effective doping) Depth

body.zh: Dose ≠ Active Concentration
body.en: Dose ≠ active concentration

body.zh: 3 耦合权衡；更温退火：；Activation与修复 ↑；Diffusion与；Thermal Budget ↑；两者需要平衡
body.en: 3 Coupled trade-offs Source phrase: warmer annealing Activation and repair ↑ Diffusion and thermal budget ↑ The two must be balanced

body.zh: 4 常见失效；Channeling（沟道效应）；Shadowing（阴影效应）；注入污染（Contamination）；激活不足（Under-Activation）；Junction Broadening（结展宽）；浓度；深度
body.en: 4 Common failures Channeling Shadowing Implantation contamination Under-activation Junction broadening Concentration Depth

body.zh: 量测反馈：；Sheet Resistance / SIMS / WAT
body.en: Metrology feedback: Sheet resistance / SIMS / WAT

body.zh: Sheet Resistance（四探针 Rs）；高Rs；低Rs；•片内均匀性与趋势
body.en: Sheet resistance (four-point Rs) High Rs Low Rs • Within-wafer uniformity and trends

body.zh: SIMS（深度剖析）；浓度；（对数）；深度；•掺杂浓度-深度分布（定性示意）
body.en: SIMS (depth profiling) Concentration (log scale) Depth • Dopant concentration versus depth (qualitative schematic)

body.zh: WAT（电学量测）；I-V曲线；C-V曲线；TLM 接触电阻；R_T；• 器件/结构电学特性验证
body.en: WAT (electrical metrology) I–V curve C–V curve TLM contact resistance R_T • Validate device/structure electrical characteristics

body.zh: 反馈调整工艺选择；调整 Dose；调整 Energy；调整 Anneal；（温度-时间）
body.en: Adjust the process through feedback Adjust dose Adjust energy Adjust anneal (temperature–time)

body.zh: 影响：Vt / Contact Resistance / Leakage / Junction Reliability
body.en: Impact: Vt / contact resistance / leakage / junction reliability

body.zh: 不同掺杂元素、晶向、器件结构和节点会采用不同注入与退火策略。
body.en: Different dopants, crystal orientations, device structures and nodes use different implantation and annealing strategies

body.zh: 5 掺杂与电性验证
body.en: 5 Verify doping and electrical properties

notes.zh: 原图写“更温退火”和“加电场（Tilt）”，文字可能不规范；保留可见文字，不擅自改成特定退火条件或偏转电场术语。
notes.en: The source says “更温退火” and “加电场 (Tilt)”; these phrases may be irregular. Visible wording is retained without inventing specific anneal conditions or a deflection-field term.

notes.zh: 原图注入说明写“穿过掩膜进入硅中”；原生示意也有掩膜开口，请结合原图理解，不将这句话扩展为所有保护区都应被穿透。
notes.en: The source says ions pass through the mask into silicon; its diagram also has mask openings. This wording is retained without implying that all protected regions should be penetrated.

uncertain: 原图写“更温退火”和“加电场（Tilt）”，文字可能不规范；保留可见文字，不擅自改成特定退火条件或偏转电场术语。
